regions.merged_text: Thanks be to God: We have thirty promising novice -- nearly all 18 yrs. old this year, if available we could place 100 priests in the missions. "The harvest . . great ... laborers are few." Bles'd be God!

regions.merged_text: The herewith enclosed came back yesterday. At first it was a surprise, - till I saw "Los Angeles" instead of Ok .- Well Grace A. and Bernard left last - p.m. (about 3:30), for Mildred and Dean's after about a 21 hours visit. Both seemed to hav enjoyed their meeting, etc, in New York and return so far. They were figuering (vaguely) on seeing too Burkhardt, Hudson, St. Paul, Superior and S. Paul and Graceville. .God bless you each and all. Glad "Clem's little one rallied so fortunately.
